tier_legend.1: own code needs only facades and hooks the P0 sim has, or its kind's runtime (kind_baselines)
tier_legend.2: needs game facades, hooks, hook parameters or model APIs the P0 sim lacks
tier_legend.3: needs a player prompt or a new subsystem (choice runtime, orbs, Osty, stars, forge, card generation, combat history, potions, enchantments, run layer)

schema_fields.kernel_requirements: requirement-catalogue keys (requirements.json) that the entry's own code needs and the P0 sim lacks
schema_fields.kernel_requirement_notes: the classifier's free-text requirements, kept for reading (mapped to keys by normalize/catalog.py)
schema_fields.dependencies: {requires, reads, co_port}: {content kind: [id]}; requires = applied, created, summoned or offered models, reads = only read or type-tested, co_port = definitions that call each other
schema_fields.prompts: ChoicePromptKind records (sim/CONTRACTS.md B1): kind, entry, site, opened_by, via, pile, min, max, require_confirm, can_skip, cancelable, context, filter, cite, notes; via names the applied power, spawned monster or offered relic whose own prompt this is (null for the entry's own prompts)
schema_fields.phases: run-scope decision phases the entry opens (Rewards, RestSite, EventCombat, CrystalSphere, Shop, PotionUse, AbandonRun): phase, role, entry, site, opened_by, via, detail, cite
schema_fields.nested_prompts: prompts of the cards the entry auto-plays
schema_fields.version_delta_v107: the classifier's v0.107.1 comparison: status same | cosmetic | rule-change | new | decompile-gap | unknown, note and its evidence fields; the reconciled, triaged list is version-deltas.json
schema_fields.tier: own code only, 1-4 (tier_legend): max of the classifier's tier and the levels of kernel_requirements; test mocks 4
schema_fields.tier_with_deps: max tier over the entry and every entry it depends on (all three relations), transitively
schema_fields.tier_classifier: the classifier's own-code tier before normalisation
schema_fields.tier_from_requirements: max requirements.json level of kernel_requirements (1 when empty)
schema_fields.port_batch: batch in this kind's scheme (cards: the unified card scheme port_batch_legend); the cross-kind order is batches.json
schema_fields.port_batch_legacy: cards: the slice classifier's own batch number
schema_fields.card_batch_raised_by: cards: required powers or tokens whose card batch is later than the mapped one

method: Every file read in full (v0.111.0 condensed state machines; v0.107.1 async source as a reading aid only, every rule re-checked in v0.111.0). Citations resolve against v0.111.0 unless prefixed [v107]. Version deltas: token fingerprint (strings, Cmd/ModelDb/enum/var/Rng tokens, comparison literals) and identifier-set comparison of both trees, then manual reading of every difference.
target_configuration: single player, GameMode.Standard, no modifiers, TestMode.IsOff, veteran unlock profile
raw_fields: every field of the raw events.json entry is kept unchanged before the added fields

glossary.EventFramework: EventModel lifecycle: BeginEvent sets Owner and the private Rng, then BeforeEventStarted, CalculateVars, SetInitialEventState -> GenerateInitialOptions (Models/EventModel.cs:68-144, :576-611); SetEventState / SetEventFinished (empty option list = finished, Models/EventModel.cs:760-810); EventOption legality (locked when OnChosen is null, Events/EventOption.cs:279, :292; DisableOnChosen guard :66; IsProceed :303-307). WillKillPlayer is a UI warning only in single player (Nodes.Events/NEventOptionButton.cs:599-623 blocks only when Players > 1).
glossary.EventRng: EventModel.Rng = new Rng(RunSeed + (IsShared ? 0 : slot) + XXH64(Id.Entry)) (Models/EventModel.cs:91). Sim already has Random/Rng.cs ForPlayerModel + Random/DeterministicHash.cs; slot is 0 in single player so IsShared does not change the seed there.
glossary.AncientFramework: AncientEventModel: arrival heal in BeforeEventStarted (Neow first sets HP to 0; heal (MaxHp-CurrentHp) x0.8 at A2 WearyTraveler; Models/AncientEventModel.cs:76-105), Hook.ShouldAllowAncient gate (no overriding model in v0.111.0; :275-289), StartPreFinished/Done (:328-351), RelicOption -> RelicCmd.Obtain + Done (:353-377; the local-function body is missing from the v0.111.0 decompile, see decompile list).
glossary.EventCombat: EventModel.EnterCombatWithoutExitingEvent (shared events only; Models/EventModel.cs:812-839) -> EventCombatSynchronizer: CombatRoom{ParentEventId, ShouldResumeParentEventAfterCombat, ExtraRewards} entered with EnterRoomWithoutExitingCurrentRoom; normal room rewards (unless ShouldGiveRewards=false) + ExtraRewards.
glossary.EventResume: EventModel.Resume(exitedRoom) override called from EventRoom.Resume after the event combat (Rooms/EventRoom.cs:373-379).
glossary.CombatLayout: EventLayoutType.Combat: at room entry EventCombatSynchronizer.InitializeForEvent builds a layout CombatState (Multiplayer.Game/EventCombatSynchronizer.cs:83-128): encounter GenerateMonstersWithSlots on a fresh mutable copy + CombatState.CreateCreature per monster, which draws RunRng.Niche for the unique HP roll (Combat/CombatState.cs:709-724, Entities.Creatures/Creature.cs:972-984). Hidden RNG use before any option.
glossary.OutOfCombatDamage: CreatureCmd.Damage / Heal / GainMaxHp (SetMaxHp then Heal of the gain) / LoseMaxHp / Kill with no live combat: HP hooks still dispatch; CreatureCmd.Kill or lethal damage ends the run (design-run-layer.md 3.14).
glossary.GoldFacades: PlayerCmd.GainGold (Hook.ModifyGoldGained, then Gold += (int)amount, Hook.AfterGoldGained; Commands/PlayerCmd.cs:237-335) and PlayerCmd.LoseGold (Gold = max(0, Gold - (int)amount), no hooks; :896-918).
glossary.DeckFacades: RunState.CreateCard / CloneCard, CardPileCmd.Add(card, Deck) (Hook.ModifyCardBeingAddedToDeck), CardPileCmd.AddCurseToDeck<T> / AddCursesToDeck, CardPileCmd.RemoveFromDeck, CardCmd.Upgrade / Downgrade.
glossary.Transform: CardCmd.TransformToRandom(card, rng) -> CardTransformation + CardFactory.CreateRandomCardForTransform: rng.NextItem over the card pool's unlocked cards filtered by rarity/id (Commands/CardCmd.cs:1949-2060, Factories/CardFactory.cs:123-163); CardCmd.TransformTo<T> (fixed replacement).
glossary.Enchant: CardCmd.Enchant<T>(card, amount) + EnchantmentModel.CanEnchant filters (Commands/CardCmd.cs:2146-2180); the enchantment models themselves are enchantments-kind content.
glossary.RewardsScreen: RewardsCmd.OfferCustom(player, rewards) opens the rewards screen (decision D2): CardReward (pick 1 of N or skip; Populate -> CardFactory.CreateForReward), PotionReward (needs a free slot), RelicReward, SpecialCardReward, GoldReward; random rewards populate on PlayerRng.Rewards unless SetRng/RngOverride.
glossary.RelicGrabBag: RelicFactory.PullNextRelicFromFront: rarity roll PlayerRng.Rewards.NextFloat (<0.5 Common, <0.83 Uncommon, else Rare) unless a rarity is given, then RelicGrabBag.PullFromFront removes the relic (and from the shared bag) (Factories/RelicFactory.cs:15-61, Runs/RelicGrabBag.cs:156-178).
glossary.CardRewardGen: CardFactory.CreateForReward(player, n, CardCreationOptions): per card Hook.ModifyCardRewardCreationOptions, rarity roll unless Uniform (PlayerOdds.CardRarity on PlayerRng.Rewards; RollWithBaseOdds for non-encounter sources, so no pity change), rng.NextItem, then an upgrade roll NextFloat unless CardCreationFlags.NoUpgradeRoll (set by ForNonCombatWithDefaultOdds/UniformOdds, Runs/CardCreationOptions.cs:109-117; WithFlags ORs) (rng = RngOverride ?? PlayerRng.Rewards; A7 Scarcity halves the per-act upgrade scaling and lowers base rarity odds) (Factories/CardFactory.cs:71-91, :166-238, Odds/CardRarityOdds.cs:53-105).
glossary.PotionPools: Character PotionPool + SharedPotionPool GetUnlockedPotions(UnlockState) concatenation (unlock-state dependent candidate list), drawn with PlayerRng.Rewards.NextItem.
glossary.DeckPrompt: CardSelectCmd deck prompts (FromDeckForRemoval/Upgrade/Transformation/Enchantment/Generic): candidates in deck order (removal: curses first), auto-resolve when candidates <= MinSelect and no manual confirmation, empty result when no candidates (Commands/CardSelectCmd.cs:3441-3666). Needs the W1 resumable prompt API.
glossary.GridPrompt: CardSelectCmd.FromSimpleGridForRewards via EventModel.SelectCardsToAddToDeckFromGrid (adds the picks to the deck, logs the rest; Models/EventModel.cs:153-300, :865-878).
glossary.StableShuffle: ListExtensions.StableShuffle = List.Sort with model CompareTo (ModelId ordinal category then entry, then card upgrade level; Models/AbstractModel.cs:126-137, Models/CardModel.cs:3649-3671) then UnstableShuffle; sim has Random/RngCollectionExtensions.cs. Equal keys keep .NET introsort order, so the sim must use List<T>.Sort on the same initial order.
glossary.PotionLock: Player.CanUseOrRemovePotions=false between BeforeEventStarted and OnEventFinished: disables potion use and discard (node-layer rule Nodes.Potions/NPotionPopup.cs:328-334, :556-565).
